subject.title: fix(ui): reject nondecimal strings in config form number coercion

question: Should generic Control UI numeric configuration fields continue to accept scientific notation such as `1e5` while rejecting radix spellings such as `0x10` and `0b1010`?
rationale: The patch changes a broad existing UI-input compatibility contract rather than only fixing the silent radix reinterpretation; the correct accepted grammar requires maintainer product intent.

options.title: Preserve scientific notation
options.body: Adjust the helper to retain scientific notation for generic number and integer fields while continuing to pass radix-like forms through as strings for schema validation.

options.title: Adopt decimal-only generic input
options.body: Keep the proposed grammar only with explicit maintainer approval and user-facing compatibility rationale for rejecting existing exponent input.

recommendation.title: Preserve scientific notation
recommendation.body: Adjust the helper to retain scientific notation for generic number and integer fields while continuing to pass radix-like forms through as strings for schema validation.
